input_evidence.summary: #10527 Improve coverage for com.hazelcast:hazelcast:5.5.0; label=library-update-request; body_chars=439

risks: Embedded members must disable multicast and use localhost TCP/IP join to avoid network flakiness in CI.

Optional integrations (Kafka, Hibernate, Spring, cloud discovery) would need extra dependencies, and some might need Docker. They are probably out of scope, so only add them if a specific uncovered access requires one.
I did not run Gradle or a native-image build, so this decision is not verified locally.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Hazelcast 5.5.0 runs embedded in the test JVM (HazelcastInstance, IMap, serialization factories, executor). It needs no Docker image or extra Maven dependency. The existing build.gradle already adds javax.cache:cache-api, awaitility and assertj, and wires in the cache-api metadata. The low coverage comes from tests not exercising more of the library's reflective paths (config loading, serializers, discovery, etc.), not from missing setup.
